messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: latency.p99 for route /v1/generate exceeded threshold. window=10m, threshold=800ms, current p99=1.6s, SLO burn ~18%

Riley (oncall): Acked. I'm on it — starting triage. Paging infra lead if it persists.

Alyssa (sre): seeing the spike in grafana, looks intermittent ~every 3-6 minutes. Correlates with nodepool downscale events at 09:04 and 09:10 UTC. link: https://grafana.example/redwood/d/abc/latency?orgId=1

Jamie (infra): grep from autoscaler logs: `scaleDown: nodepool=batch-evict, reason=utilization, timestamp=2025-06-15T09:04:12Z`

Jamie (infra): possible hypothesis: downscale evicting batch workers causing cold-tokenizer loads and KV miss amplification. Starting a temporary scale-up and bumping cooldown.

Riley (oncall): temp mitigation applied: `gcloud autoscaler update --node-pool=batch-evict --cooldown=600` (ran at 09:13). Also added one extra replica to route pool. Monitoring p99.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation scheduled in 3m if alert persists.

Lucas (product): any customer impact metrics? Are production customers timing out or getting errors?

Alyssa (sre): customer metrics: error rate unchanged, but latency-sensitive sessions see degraded experience. Roughly 3% of active sessions had p99 >2s in the 10m window. Recommend short-term UX mitigations (retry/backoff) and notify support for top affected customers.

Jamie (infra): warming KV cache and tokenizer by firing warm requests against busy keys: `for key in $(cat hotkeys.txt); do curl -s -X POST https://internal/prime -d "{\"k\":\"$key\"}" & done` — started at 09:16.

Riley (oncall): p99 trending down: 1.6s -> 930ms -> 780ms over 12 minutes. p95 steady at ~120ms. Will keep watch for 30m.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert cleared (condition no longer met). Duration: ~24m.

Alyssa (sre): next steps: file follow-up to tune nodepool autoscaler cooldown and add a runbook entry for pre-warming during scale events. I'll take ownership. @Lucas please coordinate customer comms if needed.

Lucas (product): will draft a short advisory for affected customers and loop in CS. Target send time: 2pm PST.

Riley (oncall): handing off monitoring to Alyssa for the next 2 hours; I'm stepping out for lunch. If anything spikes again, escalate to SRE lead.

Jamie (infra): created PR to set default cooldown to 5m for batch-style pools and added a telemetry alert to detect downscale-related p99 spikes. PR: https://git.example/r/pr/1234 :shipit:

Alyssa (sre): filing a postmortem stub now with notes + timeline, will include commands used and follow-ups (autoscaler tuning, runbook, warmup job).

Riley (oncall): thanks team. :thumbsup:
